text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-um! Trainer? C-could you do me a
favor?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: C-can you take a picture of me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My family says they want to see what I'm
like at
school...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've sent them plenty of pictures, but my
little
sister keeps badgering me for
more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she's just making fun of me, so I
want to nail a really good shot of me
that'll stop her
pestering! You've got to
help me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't possibly refuse to help her after
that, so we start our impromptu
photoshoot, hoping for the
perfect shot,
but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay, here I go! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a prop! I want to make it seem like
I'm calmly
reading a book while
impervious to all the chaos
around me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-no... but I see stuff like this in
magazines all the
time...
choice_data_list: ...Do you always read books in the...
...Do you always read books in the...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Is it too out of character for me? Okay,
then how
about this?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Go ahead and take the picture.
All right,
I've got this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This? It's coffee... I want to capture the
image of
me casually hanging out and
holding a cup of
coffee.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh... City...
choice_data_list: ...Who are you supposed to be copying?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I saw her in a magazine the other day,
holding a coffee in one hand and
pushing her hair back with
the other. She
looked so cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But I guess it doesn't quite fit my image,
huh?
Hm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
D-do you really think so? Hehe. I'll act
natural,
then...
choice_data_list: You're at your best when you're ju...
You're at your best when you just ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. How do I normally act again? Is
this right?
Or something like this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like she's overthinking things and
has forgotten how to act naturally. I
think of what we
can do to get her back
to normal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! As the saying goes, your true
self
doesn't hide with a friend by your
side!
choice_data_list: How about showing your family in p...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I never thought I'd have a
photoshoot
inside our classroom.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your help, Ardan and Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...How is this?
choice_data_list: Then how about everyone strike a pose?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's a very valiant pose, but it doesn't
really
capture Chiyono O's personality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How about we take a picture of
everyone sitting together and taking
notes? A display of
passionate studying
is more true to her nature.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That would be truer to her character,
but since this is for her family, wouldn't
it be better to take
a more lighthearted
photo?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You have a point... I suppose we should
do
something that embodies the spirit of
"wahey,"
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Helios often says that, and I believe it's
a signal
that something fun is about to
begin.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But wait—if it is a signal, then why does
she
always say "wahey" multiple times in

conversation?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Ahahaha! It's too funny watching
you two
say "wahey" with completely
straight faces!
Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is it strange? I've also heard her exclaim
things
like, "Wahey! We're besties for
life!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let's abandon this "wahey" idea for now.
It's a very Helios-specific concept and
not one I think
we're able to embody
just yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, concepts are a great idea! It's like
the saying goes, "the party can't start
until the vibes walk in!" Why don't we
come up with our own version
of wahey?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, are we still going along
with the
wahey idea?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A natural smile blooms across Sakura
Chiyono O's face, and I take the
opportunity to snap a picture
of her
chatting with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Did you see the picture? Hehe. Aren't
my friends
great? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, she sends the picture to
her family,
and I overhear her happily
telling them about her
school life.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Do you mean like... have a
video call
with them?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... We haven't talked
lately... I'm not
sure if that'll go well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Sakura Chiyono O is too reluctant
to do it, I take her phone to show her
family exactly what
she's like at the
academy instead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ack! Wait, why is everyone on the call?!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Younger ...
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who suddenly said you
were
gonna start a video call, so of
course we wanna
see what's up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?! You're the ones who told me on LANE yesterday that you wanted to see me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So what do you think? Go ahead and
soak in the
sight of your big sister at
Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Second O...
text_block_list.text: Are you really at Tracen Academy, though? I bet you're just lying to us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Excuse you! I picked a spot with nobody
around
because I'm considerate like
that! I really am at
Tracen right now!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Oldest B...
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, come on. Show us around. I
wanna
see what the place is like.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Is it okay if we walk around,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Younger ...
text_block_list.text:
What?! Your trainer's there?! No way! I
wanna see
what your trainer's like!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you even care about me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's call with her siblings

continues on for a long while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My little sister is just terrible!
She took a bunch of
screenshots of me during our
video call last night and sent them to
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Except they're all of me with my eyes
half-closed or making weird faces! Ugh,
she used to be so
cute, but now she's a
little brat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And my second-oldest brother kept
teasing me
too. Honestly, the only
person on my side is my
oldest brother!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But despite all her complaints, Sakura
Chiyono O
still looks extremely happy.
